NEP 2020 Implementation Faces Challenges Six Years On

Six years after its introduction, the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020's goals remain unfulfilled, with funding and structural deficiencies identified as major challenges. The policy has aimed to introduce a learner-centric approach at the school level. Progress on teacher capacity building and the development of digital platforms for education are key areas under review.
